name: Rohtas Fort
description: Rohtas Fort is a vast 16th-century fortress near the city of Dina in Pakistan's Punjab province. Sher Shah Suri began it after defeating the Mughal emperor Humayun in 1541. Walls stretching more than 4 km, studded with bastions and grand gateways, enclose the site. The fort was never taken by storm, and a village still lives inside its walls.
